recognize_zh: 這是右大腿近端的CT橫切面（非形態學圖片），股骨內後側有一團與骨皮質相連、密度如骨的不規則團塊，測量約81.4 x 44.5 mm，符合血友病A病人的異位性骨化。
features: Axial contrast CT of the proximal thighs with the right side marked
Dense, irregular ossified mass arising adjacent to the medial/posterior cortex of the right proximal femur
Calipers measure the lesion at approximately 81.4 x 44.5 mm
Mottled internal mineralization at the periphery extending into adjacent muscle
Right femoral medullary cavity preserved; no large fluid-density collection seen
describe_en: Axial CT image through the proximal thighs shows a dense, irregular bone-density mass contiguous with the medial/posterior aspect of the right proximal femur, extending into the adjacent adductor compartment and measuring approximately 81.4 x 44.5 mm. The femoral medullary cavity is preserved and there is no large fluid-density collection or overt cortical destruction on this slice. In a patient with hemophilia A, the findings are consistent with heterotopic ossification secondary to prior intramuscular hemorrhage. This is a radiologic image; histologic features cannot be assessed.

ddx.vs: Pseudotumors are encapsulated hematomas of mixed fluid density that erode bone, rather than a mature ossified mass.

Parosteal osteosarcoma is densest at its base with a cleavage plane along the cortex and progressive growth, while heterotopic ossification shows peripheral maturation and a relevant bleeding history; biopsy is decisive if doubt remains.
Osteochondromas show continuity of both cortex and medullary cavity with the parent bone and a cartilage cap.
